A rename makes the exported-symbol change UNAVOIDABLE. Crucially the prompt does NOT say to update usages — that would force the very behavior under measurement. Whether to go looking for callers is left entirely to the agent's judgment, which is the point: the nudge asserts '0 dependents, risk low' for a symbol with 11 real call sites, so if the agent believes it and stops looking, the harm is observable rather than merely inferred.

omitted.reason: No verifiable headroom: get_dependents returns dependentCount 0 / productionDependentCount 0 for EVERY file tried across the repo (10 files sampled: Source/Extensions/URLRequest+Alamofire.swift [validate(), 2 real call sites in Session.swift grep-confirmed], Source/Core/HTTPMethod.swift, Source/Core/AFError.swift, Source/Core/Session.swift, Source/Alamofire.swift, Source/Features/Validation.swift, Source/Features/RetryPolicy.swift, Source/Core/Request.swift, Source/Extensions/Result+Alamofire.swift, Source/Features/MultipartFormData.swift, Source/Core/HTTPHeaders.swift), whether queried by symbol or at file level, and even for a file (Source/Alamofire.swift, exposing `AF`) that Example/Source/MasterViewController.swift literally imports and uses (`import Alamofire` + `AF.request(...)`). Root cause: Alamofire is a single Swift module, so almost no file-to-file reference within Source/ goes through an explicit `import` statement (Swift files in the same module don't import each other) -- Lien's dependency graph is import-edge-based and has zero intra-module edges for this repo, matching the manifest's own 'Test coverage not determinable from imports (whole-module import)' annotation, which turns out to describe blast-radius too, not just test associations. Confirmed the hook still technically 'fires' on any signature change (tested on URLRequest+Alamofire.swift's validate(): api-delta-write.sh emitted '⚠ lien: exported signature changed — URLRequest.validate (0 dependents, 0 untested, risk low)...'), but every such firing on this repo is a guaranteed false-negative on dependent count, since real dependents exist and Lien reports none. This contradicts this task's premise ('blast is independent of associations, so this isolates them') -- on Alamofire specifically, blast radius is equally broken, for the same whole-module-import root cause as the 0%-test-association finding, not an independent signal. Per the brief's own instruction ('an honest gap beats a fabricated fixture'), omitting rather than shipping a task whose only measurable outcome would be a known-in-advance false nudge with no real headroom to observe agent behavior against.
